verdict.rationale: Vue.js runs an official meetup directory at events.vuejs.org/meetups/. It lists local user groups by region with city-level entries, so developers can find in-person groups, and it explains how to add a new group. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that developers actually find and join local groups through the directory, and documentation of join/RSVP flow or how current and active the listings are.

support.subject: As a developer, I can find and join a local in-person user group or meetup for the framework

citations.quote: events.vuejs.org/meetups/ is the official Vue.js Events meetup directory, listing local user groups by region (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America, Remote) with city-level entries such as "Tokyo - Vue.js Tokyo v-meetup".
